pois.name: Tanah Lot Temple
pois.address: Beraban, Kediri, Tabanan Regency, Bali 82121, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Paved pathways with handrails; keep children close near seawall edges during high tide.
pois.description: Ancient Hindu pilgrimage temple perched dramatically atop an offshore rock formation overlooking the Indian Ocean.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic Balinese sea temple with world-renowned ocean sunset vistas
✓ Sacred 16th-century architectural heritage on natural coral reef
pois.tip: Visit in late afternoon (around 16:30) to explore the grounds before the dramatic sunset over crashing waves.

pois.name: Uluwatu Temple & Sunset Amphitheatre
pois.address: Pecatu, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Spectacular cliff paths have protective walls; secure sunglasses and hats as resident monkeys are curious.
pois.description: Spectacular cliffside sea temple perched 70 meters above roaring Indian Ocean waves, famed for traditional Kecak fire dances.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Breathtaking panoramic ocean cliffs on the southern Bukit Peninsula
✓ Authentic sunset Kecak dance performance amphitheatre
pois.tip: Arrive by 16:30 if attending the 18:00 Kecak fire dance; tickets for the dance are separate (150,000 IDR).

pois.name: Padang Padang Beach
pois.address: Labuan Sait Rd, Pecatu, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Accessed via a unique cave stairway through limestone rocks; calm shallow tidal waters inside the reef suitable for children.
pois.description: Sheltered white-sand cove surrounded by dramatic limestone cliffs and clear turquoise waters, famous from Eat Pray Love.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Pristine white-sand cove protected by coral reef barrier
✓ Gentle inner lagoon waters perfect for family swimming and wading
pois.tip: Visit in the morning between 08:30 and 11:30 AM for clear swimming conditions before afternoon tides rise.

pois.name: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary, Ubud
pois.address: Jl. Monkey Forest, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Stroller-accessible paved boardwalks; brief children not to hold plastic bottles or touch monkeys.
pois.description: Lush jungle sanctuary housing over 1,000 Balinese long-tailed macaques alongside moss-covered 14th-century sacred temples.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Sacred forest nature conservation habitat in central Ubud
✓ Historic mossy dragon bridges and ancient banyan root canopies
pois.tip: Do not bring food or open plastic bags inside. Walk slowly and enjoy the shady jungle trails.

provenance.price_source: Official Entry Ticket (Adult 80,000 IDR / Child 60,000 IDR)

pois.name: Tegallalang Rice Terraces
pois.address: Jl. Raya Tegallalang, Gianyar, Bali 80561, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Terrace paths have earthen steps; upper viewing terraces and cafes are ideal for families with young children.
pois.description: Stunning emerald-green terraced valley showcasing the traditional UNESCO-recognized Balinese 'subak' irrigation system.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-famous terraced rice paddies surrounded by towering coconut palms
✓ Historic communal Subak water irrigation culture
pois.tip: Enjoy the valley views from roadside lookout cafes or walk the upper ridges in morning light.

pois.name: Tirta Empul Holy Water Temple
pois.address: Jl. Tirta, Manukaya, Tampaksiring, Gianyar, Bali 80552, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Sarongs provided at entrance; shallow clear pools with stone carvings captivate children.
pois.description: National cultural heritage site featuring crystal-clear sacred mineral springs and centuries-old purification ritual pools.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Sacred 10th-century water temple foundation
✓ Cultural Melukat ritual bathing pools under stone carved spouts
pois.tip: Sarongs and sashes are mandatory and provided with admission; lockers and changing stalls available.

pois.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk
pois.address: Kelusa, Payangan, Jl. Raya Campuhan, Sayan, Ubud, Bali 80571, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Wide paved walkway along rolling ridge; completely vehicle-free and very safe for family walks.
pois.description: Scenic 2-kilometer paved walking trail along a breezy mountain ridge between the sacred Wos rivers with sweeping hillside views.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Scenic nature walk overlooking lush river valleys and palm canopies
✓ Completely free public trail accessible from central Ubud
pois.tip: Walk early morning (07:00–08:30) or late afternoon (16:30–18:00) when sunshine is mild and breeze is cool.

pois.name: Sanur Beach Promenade
pois.address: Jl. Danau Tamblingan, Sanur, Denpasar Selatan, Bali 80228, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Flat 5km seaside paved promenade with bicycle rentals, calm protected barrier lagoon with zero undertow.
pois.description: Tranquil coastal resort beach protected by an offshore reef, offering gentle shallow waters and a scenic 5-kilometer paved beachfront promenade.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Bali's most family-friendly calm waters with reef barrier protection
✓ Paved pedestrian and bicycle path lined with shaded cafes and gelato spots
pois.tip: Rent family tandem bicycles or beach cruisers to ride the promenade from Sindhu Beach down to Mertasari.

pois.name: Ulun Danu Beratan Water Temple
pois.address: Danau Beratan, Candikuning, Baturiti, Tabanan Regency, Bali 82191, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Beautiful landscaped lake gardens with pedal swans and playground facilities; cool mountain air.
pois.description: Picturesque 17th-century Hindu-Buddhist water temple floating gracefully on the serene waters of Lake Beratan in Bali's cool central highlands.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic multi-tiered pagoda reflecting on volcanic crater lake
✓ Cool alpine mountain climate (1,200m elevation) with manicured gardens
pois.tip: Bring light jackets for children as highland temperatures are noticeably cooler (around 20–22°C).

pois.name: Ayung River White Water Rafting, Ubud
pois.address: Jl. Raya Payangan, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80572, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Family-rated Class II-III rapids suitable for children aged 7 and above; certified lifejackets and helmets provided.
pois.description: Exciting 10-kilometer river rafting journey passing dramatic rainforest gorges, natural waterfall pools, and Ramayana stone carvings.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Family-friendly Class II rapids with experienced international safety river guides
✓ Spectacular deep jungle canyon scenery and refreshing waterfall dips
pois.tip: Morning tour slots (09:00 AM) feature calmer water flow and include hot buffet lunch at the riverside pavilion.

provenance.price_source: Operator Adventure Package (350,000 IDR with Lunch & Equipment)

pois.name: Tegenungan Waterfall
pois.child_guidance: Concrete steps lead down to the river; upper scenic observation decks available for family viewing without walking down.
pois.description: Dramatic 15-meter waterfall cascading into a natural jungle pool, surrounded by dense tropical foliage in southern Gianyar.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Powerful natural waterfall accessible within 30 minutes from Ubud or Sanur
✓ Scenic photo platforms and riverbank swimming area
pois.tip: Visit before 09:30 AM to beat tour groups and enjoy peaceful morning mist.

pois.name: Bali Bird Park
pois.address: Jl. Serma Cok Ngurah Gambir, Singapadu, Batubulan, Gianyar, Bali 80582, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Paved botanical park with walk-in aviaries; interactive lorikeet feeding and 4D cinema theater loved by children.
pois.description: World-class sanctuary caring for over 1,000 birds across 250 species from Indonesia, Africa, and South America in natural walk-in habitats.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Rare Bali Starling conservation breeding center
✓ Engaging educational live bird feeding and raptor flight presentations
pois.tip: Catch the 'Free Flight Bird Show' at 10:30 AM followed by pelican feeding at 11:15 AM.

pois.name: Nusa Dua Beach & Water Blow
pois.address: Kawasan Pariwisata Nusa Dua, Benoa, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80363, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Wide, manicured promenade with lifeguard towers, white sand with crystal clear shallow swimming zones.
pois.description: Pristine manicured coastline in southern Bali featuring golden sand beaches, gentle swimming waters, and the dramatic coral Water Blow observation deck.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Gated resort peninsula with Bali's cleanest and most peaceful family beaches
✓ Natural oceanic blowhole shooting dramatic water plumes from limestone reef
pois.tip: Visit the Water Blow observation deck around mid-tide when wave pressure creates high spray plumes.

pois.name: Ubud Traditional Art Market
pois.address: Jl. Raya Ubud No.35, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Bustling cultural bazaar opposite Ubud Palace; colorful woven bags, hand-carved kites, and wooden toys children love.
pois.description: Vibrant two-story cultural market offering hand-woven ikat textiles, hand-carved wooden sculptures, woven rattan bags, and Balinese artwork.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Center of traditional artisanal handicrafts in central Ubud
✓ Opposite historic Ubud Royal Palace
pois.tip: Polite friendly bargaining is customary; shop morning hours for 'penglaris' (auspicious first-customer prices).

pois.name: Jimbaran Bay Beachfront Seafood Cafes
pois.address: Jl. Pantai Muaya, Jimbaran, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Tables set directly in the soft sand right at the water's edge; children can safely play in the sand while waiting for food.
pois.description: Famous open-air beachfront dining strip where tables are set directly in the sand, renowned for grilled seafood marinated in Balinese spices under the stars.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic Balinese candlelit dinner with toes in the sand at sunset
✓ Fresh local seafood grilled over aromatic coconut husk charcoal
pois.tip: Arrive around 17:15 to watch the sunset paint the sky over the bay before dinner is served.
pois.signature_dish: Grilled red snapper with Balinese sambal matah and water spinach (kangkung)

provenance.price_status: A la carte dining (No entry ticket)
provenance.price_source: A la carte menu (No entry ticket)

pois.name: Bebek Bengil (Dirty Duck Diner), Ubud
pois.address: Jl. Hanoman, Padangtegal, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Garden restaurant with open pavilions (bale) nestled among private lotus ponds and rice paddies.
pois.description: Historic Ubud culinary landmark nestled inside lush garden grounds, famed as the pioneer of authentic crispy Balinese duck.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic Balinese crispy spiced duck cooked with traditional herbs
✓ Peaceful dining gazebos overlooking landscaped lotus waterways
pois.tip: Request a traditional garden gazebo (bale) towards the back overlooking the private rice field.
pois.signature_dish: Crispy fried duck served with steamed rice, Balinese vegetables, and trio of sambals

provenance.price_status: A la carte dining (No entry ticket)
provenance.price_source: A la carte menu (No entry ticket)

pois.name: Locavore NXT Restaurant
pois.address: Jl. A.A. Gede Rai No.10, Lodtunduh, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
pois.child_guidance: Fine-dining tasting menu concept; recommended for adults and older teens.
pois.description: Celebrated culinary institution presenting hyper-local Indonesian gastronomy utilizing 100% archipelago-sourced produce.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Acclaimed modern Indonesian fine dining championing local farming cooperatives
✓ Creative multi-course tasting menus with vegetarian excellence
pois.tip: Reserve at least 2 to 3 weeks in advance for dinner services.
pois.signature_dish: Balinese heritage heirloom grain risotto with wild forest mushrooms

provenance.price_status: A la carte dining (No entry ticket)
provenance.price_source: A la carte & tasting menu (No entry ticket)
